libraryAudit.name: audiojs/beat
libraryAudit.license: MIT text followed by Krishnized link; dependency notices preserved in private audit; no third-party source copied in this public export.
libraryAudit.comparator: source-level cached-ODF only; not npm high-level PCM end-to-end
libraryAudit.confidence: Actual beatTrack selected-frame raw ODF mass / total ODF mass; no fake1, not correctness probability; prefix extrapolation excluded from numerator.
libraryAudit.output: All stock beats retained, including backward prefix; interval-derived tempo; unknown downbeats[] and meterConfidence0.
libraryAudit.adaptiveClaim: One global combTempo targetPeriod; no local BPM trajectory or previous-lag state; do not call it a proven adaptive musical clock.
libraryAudit.ownRawCacheEquivalence: Separate subsequent comparator test, not upstream CI evidence.

bandAudit.interpretation: Some retrospective band-identity evidence exists; scalar E loses contributor identity but weighted preprocessing preserves some concurrence. HP low-band presence distinguishes aggregate GT/wrong groups but12–20s both100%; wrong side can be stronger. Not a stable rule, causal proof, new algorithm or promise of beat-layer recovery.
